meta.title: Swarm Rebuild · 群蜂建站
meta.description: While an AI agent writes a webpage, a swarm of multiplayer cursors rebuilds the page from a blank canvas, exactly like Swarm Rebuild. The page first fades to a blueprint: a dark ruler strip appears along the top and left edges with tick marks and numbers, and the site icon sits in the middle while eighteen cursors swirl around it in flocking curves. Then they scatter and claim blocks one at a time. A crosshair drags a 1px blue selection frame out over a block and the block grows with it; a size badge such as 240 × 96 floats under the frame while the ruler highlights the measured span and blue dashed guide lines run from the rulers to the frame; red measurement guides snap into place and flash. Text blocks switch the cursor to an I-beam, which types the real words character by character with word pauses and the occasional thinking pause, a caret blinking at the end, and the selection frame growing taller as each line lands. Once a block is fully drawn it turns solid with its real colour. Eight to forty-eight cursors are in flight at once and their number rises as the page gets busier; when the last block is done they gather into a loose flock that swirls once and leaves, the blueprint fades, and the real page is left behind completely clean, with no overlay, no ruler and no endless loop. The animation plays again only when the AI modifies, adds or deletes page content. The developing page opens automatically in the Harness right sidebar, and the same address in any external browser shows the same effect.
